title: Federated Foundation Models over Vehicular Networks
abstract: arXiv:2606.06786v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents a forward-looking vision for integrating the emerging multi-modal multi-task federated foundation models (M3T FedFMs) into vehicular networks, with the goal of unifying the expressive power of multi-modal multi-task foundation models (M3T FMs) with the privacy-preserving and distributed learning capabilities of federated learning (FL). Given the largely underexplored nature of this research direction, we first introduce the fundamental training/fine-tuning principles of M3T FedFMs. We then discuss a range of their representative use cases in vehicular networks, illustrating the significant potential of M3T FedFMs to enable next-generation vehicular intelligence. Afterwards, we identify key constraints inherent to vehicular environments that challenge the practical deployment of M3T FedFMs, and articulate a set of forward-looking research directions to address these challenges. translated_abstract: 本文提出了将新兴的多模态多任务联邦基础模型（M3T FedFMs）集成到车联网中的前瞻性愿景，旨在将多模态多任务基础模型（M3T FMs）的强大表达能力与联邦学习（FL）的隐私保护和分布式学习能力相统一。鉴于该研究方向在很大程度上尚未被充分探索，我们首先介绍了M3T FedFMs的基本训练/微调原理。随后，我们讨论了它们在车联网中的一系列代表性用例，展示了M3T FedFMs在实现下一代车联网智能方面的巨大潜力。接着，我们识别了车联网环境中固有的、制约M3T FedFMs实际部署的关键约束条件，并提出了一系列前瞻性的研究方向来应对这些挑战。此外，通过一个案例研究……（原文截断）
tldr: 本文首次提出了将多模态多任务联邦基础模型集成到车联网中的前瞻性愿景，系统阐述了其训练/微调原理、代表性应用场景、车联网环境中的关键部署挑战以及未来研究方向。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a forward-looking vision for integrating multi-modal multi-task federated foundation models into vehicular networks, systematically covering their training/fine-tuning principles, representative use cases, key deployment constraints in vehicular environments, and future research directions.
